hero.title: Built for Executive Candour
hero.description: Mass conferences produce fleeting soundbites. AIX Summit is structured to produce durable intellectual output by putting the right people in a closed room and focusing on the friction of actual deployment.

rationale.title: Why One Day, Six Roundtables, and a Curated Room
paragraphs: Senior executives do not have time for multi-day passive listening. A single, focused day concentrates attention. 75 minutes is precisely calibrated: long enough to move past superficial generalities and interrogate live bottlenecks, yet short enough to maintain high engagement.
The value of any summit is defined by who is not in the room. By capping attendance at ~110 and enforcing strict seniority thresholds, AIX ensures peer-level dialogue.
Generic tech events focus on what AI might do in the future. AIX is strictly concerned with what AI is doing right now in secure, scaled, enterprise environments.
